podcast.author: hyobimaeng
podcast.description: 每天自动更新的 Bloomberg 公开 RSS 中文加长摘要，覆盖更多重点，适合更长通勤收听。

episodes.title: 每日财经简报（2026年3月20日）
episodes.summary: 今日聚焦欧洲政治、金融市场动态以及中国相关话题。

sources.title: EU Says Orban Not Honoring His Word on Ukraine Loan Deal (Video)
FTSE 100 to Steady After Bruising Session in European Stocks
ECB Would Need April Hike If Price Outlook Sours, Nagel Says
sources.description: The European Central Bank will need to consider hiking interest rates as soon as next month if price pressures build further due to the Iran war, according to Governing Council member Joachim Nagel.

sources.title: South Africa Imposes Anti-Dumping Duties on Chinese, Thai Steel
sources.description: South Africa approved new import taxes to protect its steel industry after a probe found that cheap imports of some products from China and Thailand unfairly undercut local manufacturers.

sources.title: Bollore’s Shock Dividend Has Investors Baffled About Endgame
sources.description: Vincent Bolloré’s surprise proposal to pay out €4.2 billion ($4.8 billion) from the eponymous company sitting at the heart of his tangled empire has spawned a slew of theories about the French billionaire’s endgame.

sources.title: The Anti-War Democrat Courting MAGA Voters
sources.description: Congressman Ro Khanna of California helped force the Epstein Files release. He tells Mishal Husain why opposing the Iran war and taxing billionaires can unite progressives and wavering Trump voters. (Source: Bloomberg)

sources.title: US Soy Ships Pile Into China as Trump Summit Delay Clouds Trade
sources.description: A wave of US soybeans reached Chinese shores this year as a deal between the two nations revived the trade. But the delay of President Donald Trump’s visit to Beijing is clouding prospects over how long the influx will last.

digest.episode_summary: 今日聚焦欧洲政治、金融市场动态以及中国相关话题。
digest.lead: 今天，我们关注到欧盟对奥尔班的批评，FTSE 100指数在昨日经历了一番波动后趋于稳定。同时，关于中国的市场动态和经济政策也备受瞩目。

stories.headline: 欧盟指责奥尔班未履行与乌克兰贷款协议
stories.summary: 欧盟表示匈牙利总理奥尔班没有遵守有关乌克兰的贷款协议条款。
stories.why_it_matters: 这一事件反映了国际社会对匈牙利在支持乌克兰方面立场的关注。

stories.headline: FTSE 100指数今日趋于稳定
stories.summary: 尽管昨日经历了一番波动，今日欧洲主要股市的FTSE 100指数已经趋于平稳。
stories.why_it_matters: 这表明市场情绪正在逐渐恢复平衡。

stories.headline: 中国市场的最新动态
stories.summary: 《The China Show》节目展示了最新的中国市场情况。
stories.why_it_matters: 通过这个节目，观众可以了解到当前中国的经济和政治动向。

stories.headline: 欧洲央行可能在4月加息以应对通胀压力
stories.summary: 根据欧央行成员Joachim Nagel的言论，如果未来价格压力持续存在，欧洲央行可能会在下个月进行加息。
stories.why_it_matters: 这将影响全球金融市场和投资者的投资决策。

stories.headline: 南非对来自中国和泰国的钢铁产品征收反倾销税
stories.summary: 为了保护国内钢铁制造商免受低价进口产品的冲击，南非政府批准了新的关税。
stories.why_it_matters: 这将影响相关行业的供应链和国际贸易关系。

stories.headline: Bollore公司意外宣布分红计划引发市场困惑
stories.summary: Vincent Bolloré的公司提议支付42亿欧元（约48亿美元）的股息，这一举动引发了投资者对其未来动向的猜测。
stories.why_it_matters: 这将影响Bollore公司的市值和股东利益。

digest.closing: 在今天的新闻中，我们看到了国际政治、经济动态以及中国市场的发展变化。希望这些信息能够帮助您更好地了解世界正在发生的事情。
